name: edi-openflow-parser
description: EDI parsing framework for Snowflake. Guides customers through extending an Openflow-based EDI pipeline for any transaction format (X12 834/835/837/270-277 pre-built, extensible to any EDI type). Includes AI-assisted field map generation, typed landing tables, Gold Dynamic Tables with Cortex AI enrichment, and a Python UDF lite path for environments without Openflow.
